first.rationale: The simultaneous declines in onboarding completion and activation make onboarding simplification the best-supported intervention for sustainable adoption. Verify memory_86 for downstream product and revenue effects, while checking memory_73 as the strongest alternative given competitive pricing pressure. Judge the experiment on qualified activation and revenue signals, not completion alone.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment shortening onboarding. The verified prior produced +13% completion, 2.1-day faster time-to-value, and +3% 30-day retention, directly addressing both current declines with evidence of downstream durability. Do not prioritize promotional pricing: despite acquisition and qualified-revenue lift, verified retention fell 12% and the cohort failed to survive first renewal. Measure qualified activation and retention alongside completion and time-to-value.
